item.title: Burgaw man sentenced for deadly hit-and-run crash in Wilmington
item.description: A Burgaw man pleaded guilty in court on Tuesday to felony hit and run causing death, DWI, and felony death by motor vehicle.

item.title: Security incident near Tarawa Terrace Elementary School resolved; one death confirmed
item.description: In a press release, Marine Corps Base Camp Lejune confirmed a reported security incident near Tarawa Terrace Elementary School Tuesday afternoon has been resolved.

item.title: Nearly 200K evictions filed in NC and 3K filed in NHCO in 2025: New Study
item.description: A new study from the North Carolina Housing Coalition found a major rise in evictions in 2025 compared to previous years. The report says there were almost 200,000 evictions filed in the state last year.

item.title: Brunswick County Board of Elections begins logic and accuracy testing ahead of primary
item.description: The Brunswick County Board of Elections officially began logic and accuracy testing on Tuesday.

item.title: Wilmington Housing Authority addresses rent increase policy
item.description: The Wilmington Housing Authority met Tuesday afternoon to clarify a new policy regarding rent increases.

item.title: What to know about the protests in Iran, the crackdown and Tehran’s relations with the world
item.description: Nationwide protests in Iran sparked by the Islamic Republic's ailing economy are putting pressure on its theocracy, which has responded with a deadly crackdown and shutting down the internet.

item.title: Topsail picks up road win over West Brunswick 58-36
item.description: In the lone Carolina Coast girls basketball matchup on Tuesday, Topsail came out on top at West Brunswick 58-36.

item.title: Massive 1st quarter propels West Brunswick to 74-36 win over Topsail
item.description: After dropping their first three, the West Brunswick boys got their first Carolina Coast Conference win at home Tuesday over Topsail 74-36.

item.title: Some Echo Farms resident voice concerns about variance request for proposed project
item.description: Plans filed for a small property at one of the entrances to the Echo Farms community are raising concerns for dozens of residents.

item.title: Panthers GM says team will pick up QB Bryce Young’s 5th year option, no timeline on extension
item.description: Carolina Panthers general manager Dan Morgan said the team plans to pick up the fifth-year option on quarterback Bryce Young's contract, but stopped short of saying whether the team will begin long-term contract extension discussions with the 2023 No. 1 overall pick.
